question: Should this repository adopt the proposed pre-release source-alias integration and local proof-adapter model as its supported starter direction?
rationale: The change establishes the repository's central integration architecture and relies on exact pre-release source pins, so implementation correctness alone cannot determine whether this should become the maintained product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded pilot
options.body: Accept the pinned, disposable proof-only integration as the starter direction once inspectable final-head behavior evidence is attached.

options.title: Narrow to documentation or scaffolding
options.body: Keep only the neutral starter structure until the upstream Commerce and Inventory packages have supported installable releases.
